reviews.text: Used to be good. There are products that I know are harmful that are showing up as “good”. For example, I looked up fabric sheets that clearly lists PET which is known to leach Phthalates and it skips over that ingredient and highlights a different ingredient in green. No warnings whatsoever. It seems like they’re going with what the FDA claims is good. Super upsetting because this was one of the apps I trusted. Not any more.

reviews.text:
Thank you!. So thankful for this app! I appreciate all the hard work you put in to keeping us consumer informed when making decisions that will effect us for a life time. I had no idea how many toxic chemicals we absorb on a daily basis and I had no idea that the US only bans apparently around 11 chemicals in skincare. And Europe bans over 1,300! 
I have completely changed all my skin care, beauty products and most other things I allow in my house. 
I just wish I had started this sooner! 
Thank you!

reviews.text:
Alternative Menstrual Products not Supported. I downloaded this app specifically to search for safer alternatives to Thinx underwear in light of their recent settlement RE: PFA use. 

Clearya’s own blog discusses period underwear and menstrual cups and specifies that ingredients in period products are covered by the app. But searches for these products indicate they are “not supported.” 

Searches for reusable pads don’t bring up the same message so the issue isn’t just lack of a clear ingredient list. Really disappointing.

reviews.text: Game-changer for reducing toxin exposures. SO helpful. After waking up to the formaldehyde, endocrine disrupters and talc in my personal care products I started to feel overwhelmed by the task of deciphering ingredient labels. This app does the work for me and I use it while at Target when choosing between products. I do wish it had a barcode scanner but it’s the best free app available that I’ve tried and it’s been the biggest help in becoming more informed about the products I’m choosing for myself and my family. Just wish j had know about it sooner!
